params.name: page_size

params.name: page_size
params.description: Results per page. Default 50, maximum 1000; rate limits cap a single request at 500 fetched records.

params.name: filters
params.description: JSON array of filter objects: {"attribute", "operator", "value"}. Operators: equal, not_equal, in, not_in, greater_than, less_than, between_dates. Dates use ISO 8601.

params.name: group_by
params.description: JSON array of grouping objects: {"attribute", "max_group_number"} (analytics endpoints only).

params.name: aggregation
params.description: JSON array of aggregation objects, e.g. {"attribute": "session_duration", "operator": "max"}.

params.name: comparison
params.description: Set to 1 to compare the current period against the previous period.

items.docs: Aggregated user metrics such as user_count and avg_user_session_duration, with filters, group_by, aggregation, and comparison.
